A  G  E  N  D  A
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
  ORANGE COUNTY, CALIFORNIA

  Tuesday, November 28, 2023
  9:00 A.M. Presentations
  9:30 A.M. Regular Business

  BOARD HEARING ROOM, FIRST FLOOR
  400 W. Civic Center Drive
  Santa Ana, California

  DONALD P. WAGNER
  CHAIRMAN
  Third District

ANDREW DO  VICENTE
VICE CHAIRMAN  SARMIENTO
First District  SUPERVISOR
  Second District

DOUG CHAFFEE  KATRINA FOLEY
SUPERVISOR  SUPERVISOR
Fourth District  Fifth District

COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER  COUNTY COUNSEL  CLERK OF THE BOARD
Frank Kim  Leon J. Page  Robin Stieler

This agenda contains a brief description of each item to be considered. Except as provided by
law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing in the agenda. To speak on an item,
complete a Speaker Request Form(s) identifying the item(s) and deposit the completed form(s) in
the box to the left of the podium. To speak on a matter not appearing in the agenda, but under
the jurisdiction of the Board of Supervisors, you may do so during Public Comments at the end
of the meeting. Speaker request forms must be deposited prior to the beginning of the consent
calendar, the reading of the individual agenda items, the opening of the public hearing and/or the
beginning of Public Comments. When addressing the Board, it is requested that you state your
name and city of residence for the record. Members of the public desiring to speak should
address all remarks and questions to the Board. Speakers may address the Board on up to three
occasions, with three minutes allotted to the speaker per occasion. PowerPoint and video
presentations must be requested in advance of the meeting through the Clerk.
  Supporting documentation is available for review in the Clerk of the Board of Supervisors office:
  400 W. Civic Center Drive, First Floor, Room 110, Santa Ana, 92701 8:00 am - 5:00 pm, Monday-
  Friday.
  The Agenda is available online at: https://board.ocgov.com/meetings-agendas
  Meetings are broadcast live at https://board.ocgov.com/board-meeting-media-archive
  To listen to live Board meetings by telephone, please call (866)590-5055, Access Code: 4138489
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ------
  If you have special needs, such as ADA accommodation or need the services of a language
  interpreter,
  the Clerk of the Board can assist you. To make such requests, please call the Board Services
  Division at least 72 hours prior to the meeting at 714-834-2206. Requests made less than 72
  hours prior to the meeting will still receive every effort by Clerk of the Board to fulfill the
  request.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -------

INVOCATION:Supervisor Chaffee, Fourth District

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:Supervisor Sarmiento, Second District

I.PRESENTATIONS/INTRODUCTIONS

Chairman Wagner and Supervisor Foley will be presenting a resolution proclaiming November 12 -18,
2023 as "National Nurse Practitioner Week"
Supervisor Chaffee will be presenting a resolution congratulating Children and Families Commission,
First 5 Orange County on their 25th Anniversary

II.CONSENT CALENDAR (Items 1-8)

All matters are approved by one motion unless pulled by a Board Member for discussion or separate
action.At this time, any member of the public may ask the Board to be heard on any item on the Consent
Calendar.

BOARD APPOINTMENTS

Chairman Wagner:

1.  Orange County Behavioral Health Advisory Board - Appoint Linda M. Smith, Yorba
  Linda, to complete term ending 3/9/27

2.  Rescind Board action taken on 10/17/23, Item S28F appointing Dr. Voiza Arnold to
  complete term ending 12/4/24; and appoint Dr. Voiza Arnold in lieu of election to
  Placentia Library District Board of Trustees to complete term ending 12/2/26

OC COMMUNITY RESOURCES

3.  Approve amendment 2 to contract MA-012-23010312 with Community Legal Aid SoCal for
  Legal Assistance Services Program, 1/1/24 - 9/30/24 ($262,675; cumulative total $537,675); and
  authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - All
  Districts

4.  Approve shared use agreement and Grant of Nonexclusive Easements between BEACH2
   HOUSING PARTNERS LP and JHC-BEACH3 LLC and subordination of loan with JHC-
  BEACH2 LLC for development of Tahiti Apartment Homes, Stanton ($2,400,000); and
  authorize Director or designee to execute related documents - District 4

OC PUBLIC WORKS

5.  Approve Orange County Traffic Committee report dated 9/21/23 - Item A; adopt resolution
  establishing 30 mph speed limit on Modjeska Grade Road between Santiago Canyon Road to
  Modjeska Canyon Road; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption
  findings under CEQA Guidelines section 15301 - District 3

6.  Award contract MA-080-23011027 to West Coast Air Conditioning Company, Inc for pre-
  construction services for County Operations Center Chiller Plant Replacement Project, effective
  upon execution ($97,700); authorize Director or designee to execute contract; and make
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines
  sections 15301 and 15302 - District 2

7.  Adopt resolution affirming County's commitment to projects submitted in 2025 Federal
  Transportation Improvement Program - All Districts

SOCIAL SERVICES AGENCY

8.  Approve non-financial Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) MA-063-24010491 with
  California Department of Child Support Services to extend access to Child Support Enforcement
  System, 1/1/24 - 12/31/26; and authorize Director or designee to execute MOU and related
  documents as required - All Districts
  END OF CONSENT CALENDAR

III.DISCUSSION ITEMS (Items 9-24)

At this time, members of the public may ask the Board to be heard on the following items as those items
are called.

Sheriff-Coroner:

  Range for use of outdoor range for firearms training, 1/28/24 - 1/27/25 ($58,300;
  cumulative total $154,900); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized
  designee to execute amendment - All Districts

  increase not to exceed 10% under certain conditions and execute contract - All Districts

OC COMMUNITY RESOURCES

14.  Approve contract MA-012-23011527 with Parking Concepts, Inc. for OC Parks Parking
  Management services, 1/1/24 - 12/31/26 ($14,175,000); renewable for one additional two-year
  term; authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute contract; and
  make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA
  Guidelines Section 15301 - All Districts

OC PUBLIC WORKS

15.  Approve amendment 2 to contract MA-080-21011313 with De Novo Planning Group for
  General Plan Update - Consultant Services, term ending 5/25/26 (cumulative total $1,303,450);

16.  Approve retroactive contract MA-080-23011124 with Kitchell-CEM, Inc. for payment of
  construction management services for Juvenile Hall Multipurpose Rehabilitation Center Project,

  updated appropriation for Cash/In-Kind Match and identifying source of Match for architectural,
  California Environmental Quality Act, construction management and State agency fees; and
  authorize Director or designee to execute contract - District 2

17.  Approve Orange County Traffic Committee Report of 9/21/23 - Item B to amend Orange
  County Ordinance 6-4-204; consider first reading of "An Ordinance of the County of Orange,
  California Amending Ordinance Number 3768 Which Adopted Orange County Ordinance 6-4-
  204, Membership"; set second reading and adoption for 12/5/23, 9:30 a.m.; and adopt resolution
  approving amendment to Traffic Committee By-laws updating Traffic Committee membership -
  All Districts

Acting as the Board of Supervisors and Orange County Flood Control District:

18.  Approve amendment 1 to renew contract MA-080-21010645 with Myers & Sons Hi-
   Way Safety, Inc. for construction site flagger services, 12/11/23 - 12/10/24 ($300,000;
  cumulative total $1,800,000); renewable for one additional one-year term; and authorize
  County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - All
  Districts

19.  Approve amendment 1 to aggregate contract MA-080-21010437 with Downstream
  Services, Inc., 1/8/24 - 1/7/25, and Nor-Cal Pipeline Services, 1/5/24 - 1/4/25, for storm
  drain, sewer pipe inspection and maintenance services ($2,000,000; cumulative
  aggregate total $5,000,000); renewable for one additional one-year term; and authorize
  County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendments - All
  Districts

SOCIAL SERVICES AGENCY

20.  Accept Grant Award for ComplexCare Capacity Building, term ending 6/30/26 ($1,035,000);
  and authorize Director or designee to accept grant award and execute related documents under
  certain conditions - All Districts

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

County Executive Office:

21.  DELETED
  Approve 2024 Contract Policy Manual, effective 1/1/24; and adopt resolution
  authorizing OC Public Works Director, Sheriff-Coroner or those qualified County
  officials or department designees to advertise bids in manner set forth in Public Contract
  Section 22037 for performance of public projects described in Public Contract Code
  Section 22032(c) - All Districts (Continued from 10/31/23, Item 23; 11/7/23, Item
  S12C)

22.  Approve recommended positions on introduced or amended legislation and/or consider
  other legislative subject matters - All Districts

23.  Approve contract MA-017-24010544 with Townsend Public Affairs, Inc. for
  Federal Legislative Advocacy services, 1/1/24 - 12/31/26 ($720,000); renewable for two
  additional one-year terms; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized
  designee to execute contract - All Districts

24.  Approve grant applications/awards submitted in 11/28/23 grant report and other actions
  as recommended - All Districts
  County Executive Office – Approve grant applications/awards submitted by Public
  Defender, Health Care Agency, District Attorney, Sheriff-Coroner and OC Community
  Resources, and retroactive grant applications/awards submitted by Health Care
  Agency in 11/28/23 grant report and other actions as recommended; adopt resolution
  authorizing Public Defender or designee to submit and execute application and related
  documents with Office of the State Public Defender for Racial Justice for All; adopt
  resolution authorizing Chief of Mental Health and Recovery Services to execute
  application, standard agreement and related documents with California Department of

   execute grant award agreements and amendments with California Governor’s Office of

  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings pursuant to CEQA
  Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3) and other findings; adopt resolution authorizing Sheriff-
  Coroner or designee to execute, submit application and grant assurances to California
  Office of Emergency Services for FY 2023 Emergency Management Performance Grant
  ($750,854); adopt resolution authorizing Sheriff-Coroner or designee to execute
  application, grant assurances and related documents to California Office of Emergency
  Services FY 2023 Homeland Security Grant Program ($3,091,413) and approving

S24A.  Supervisor Foley - Orange County Waste Management Commission - Appoint Kelly

S24B.  Supervisor Foley - Assessment Appeals Board No. 4 – Appoint David Goldwasser,

S24C.  Chairman Wagner and Vice Chairman Do – Establish Orange County Hall of Fame;

S24D.  Sheriff-Coroner – Approve amendment 2 to contract MA-060-21010542 with

S24F.  Supervisor Chaffee - Orange County Workforce Development Board - Appoint George

OC COMMUNITY RESOURCES

SCS3.  County Counsel - CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION -

SCS4.  County Counsel - CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION –

VI.PUBLIC, CEO, ADJOURNMENT & BOARD COMMENTS

PUBLIC COMMENTS:

At this time, members of the public may address the Board of Supervisors regarding any off-agenda items
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board of Supervisors provided that NO action may be taken
on off-agenda items unless authorized by law.Comments shall be limited to three minutes per person,
unless different time limits are set by the Chair subject to the approval of the Board.

COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER COMMENTS:

ADJOURNED:

BOARD COMMENTS:

At this time, members of the Board of Supervisors may comment on agenda or non-agenda matters.
